To the rider and the driver: the $5.00 no-show cancellation fee stands, and the driver is owed $4.00 (80% of that fee), with $1.00 retained by the platform as its service fee.

How to appeal: You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 4.00 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

Rider advocate4 claim(s), 4 kept

  1. The rider did coordinate and the driver did not answer.

    Read the whole claim

    EV-CHAT-02703 shows the driver writing 'hi im at the bay, where are you' at 07:53:25 and the rider replying 'coming' at 07:55:20, inside the waiting window; the driver posted nothing in the following 120 seconds and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so limbs (a) and (b) of POL-NS-04 are made out. Limb (c) is not, and I do not pretend otherwise: the rider's own track in EV-GPS-02703 places the rider's device between 796.46 m and 804.18 m from the pickup pin (mean 800.51 m) across all 90 fixes, with rider_qualifying_fix_count 0 against the 200 m rider-presence radius for TRANSPORT_HUB. Even on the reading most favourable to the rider - limb (c) undecidable because no fix survives the accuracy filter, POL-NS-11 - the clause still cannot exonerate, so this route yields the rider no refund.

    EV-CHAT-02703, EV-GPS-02703, EV-TRIP-02703 · POL-NS-04, POL-NS-11

  2. The waiting-period arithmetic runs against the rider and I state it rather than stretch it.

    Read the whole claim

    The free waiting period in force is 300 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, carried on EV-TRIP-02703), and the derived arrival facts in EV-GPS-02703 show one continuous in-geofence run of 556 seconds, from 07:53:00 to 08:02:16, that is a shortfall of -256 seconds. The cancellation at 08:02:20 is 556 seconds after the first qualifying in-geofence fix, so it also falls at or after the 480 second no_show_threshold_sec in force. POL-NS-06 - the rider's cleanest arithmetic route to a full refund of the cancellation-fee line - cannot be run on these numbers, and POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied on them. EV-FARE-02703 shows the $5.00 cancellation fee charged with refund_issued_sgd 0.00.

    EV-GPS-02703, EV-TRIP-02703, EV-FARE-02703 · POL-NS-06, POL-NS-01

  3. The rider's side does not concede platform-confirmed arrival.

    Read the whole claim

    The event chain in EV-TRIP-02703 runs driver_assigned, driver_en_route, driver_arrived, wait_timer_started, trip_cancelled - there is no wait_timer_expired event. POL-NS-12 makes the platform's GPS_AUTO arrival and wait-timer events a carrier independent of the exported trace only where wait_timer_started AND wait_timer_expired are both carried, so on this record that route is not made out and the arrival and served-dwell facts must come out of the exported trace. I disclose honestly that this does not by itself displace the fee: EV-GPS-02703 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and shows the same 556 second continuous run, so the gap in the event chain removes a carrier without removing the fact the driver needs.

    EV-TRIP-02703, EV-GPS-02703 · POL-NS-12, POL-NS-01

  4. No advisory covers the pickup road: EV-ADVIS-02703-01 is MISSING, carries issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight_multiplier 0.0, and has no payload.

    Read the whole claim

    Under POL-NS-06 limb (i) a present and populated traffic_advisory is the only thing that permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed, and under POL-GEN-02 a MISSING artifact can carry no fact at all. The rider therefore puts the driver's side to proof of any advisory-based excuse for its position or its intervals; the record supplies none. This is a citable absence rather than a fact, and it produces no refund here, because the driver's dwell is a single uninterrupted 556 second run that needs no accumulation.

    EV-ADVIS-02703-01, EV-GPS-02703 · POL-NS-06, POL-GEN-02
